_comment: Planetary reference regions. Each entry points at an official STAC item in the USGS Astrogeology analysis-ready-data archive on AWS (s3://astrogeo-ard). Window centres are derived at build time from the item itself; nothing here is a measured value.

targets.name: Jezero crater region (CTX DTM)
targets.selection: CTX DTM whose footprint contains the Mars 2020 Perseverance landing area (approx. 18.44 N, 77.45 E; approximate value from public NASA mission information, used only to choose the DTM) and whose centroid is nearest to it among 29 covering DTMs in the USGS index.

targets.name: Gale crater region (CTX DTM)
targets.selection: CTX DTM whose footprint contains the MSL Curiosity landing area (approx. 4.59 S, 137.44 E; approximate, used only to choose the DTM) and whose centroid is nearest to it among the 16 covering DTMs that carry a STAC item.

targets.name: Meridiani Planum (CTX DTM)
targets.selection: CTX DTM whose footprint contains the MER Opportunity landing area (approx. 1.95 S, 5.53 W; approximate, used only to choose the DTM) and whose centroid is nearest to it among the 16 covering DTMs that carry a STAC item.

targets.name: Southern Utopia Planitia (CTX DTM)
targets.selection: CTX DTM whose footprint contains the Tianwen-1 Zhurong landing area (approx. 25.07 N, 109.93 E; approximate, used only to choose the DTM).
